title: Launch Shipped
description: Stand up Shipped (shipped.anth.us), a Papyrus publication of community-ranked AI that actually shipped: announcements and real-world deployments, including open-weights releases and decision models used in the wild. Placeholder site first; design by Ryan in Claude Design. Infrastructure follows the Distinctive Mark pattern (CMS Amplify app, S3 projection, one CloudFront edge, Google sign-in).
